area: Keystone testbed: content digests for the render assets

find.report_claim: keystone.content gives stable SHA-256 digests for mesh and material payloads so separately loaded equal assets share a render group; the shooter had never imported it even though cycle 138 retargeted its batching pins to content-keyed grouping
find.live_evidence: build_scene registers dozens of meshes and materials with no stable content identity exposed to an AI/soak consumer; object identity differs between two registries of the same shipped asset
find.consumer_evidence: mesh_digest(cube(1.0)) equals the digest of a separately built mesh.wall payload while their Python objects differ, and a different cube size produces a different digest
